title: Wardrobe: snap a pile of clothes, get clean cutouts draped on a photo of you
description:
Snap a photo of a pile of clothes on your bed and Wardrobe pulls out every garment as its own clean product cutout, no background, then optionally drapes each piece onto a modeled photo of you. The app keeps its image library and JSON database local, while bundled Codex skills can import entire folders or assemble new outfit ideas. It feels like a personal inventory system built around clothes you actually own.

https://github.com/tandpfun/wardrobe
